note: steps are in the model scheduler's order; a jspi host parks every writer at capacity, independently of B and the write size, and every reader of an empty pipe with a live writer; a local host parks bash on reads only, and a child never parks: a non-parking write appends when the pipe is empty (even for a write larger than B) or its resulting queue fits B, else the writer is suspended and the scheduler runs nested; a read that would wait on writers all suspended beneath it, or a scheduler with nothing to run while a frame is suspended, stops the command with a named error (match any {aborted}: the runtime has one message for both, with its B figure); the last read end's close discards what is in flight; a writer on a local host that exits with more than C unread in a pipe it writes, with a reader left, is held ({exited, held:true}); each such pipe releases it at the first step after which it holds at most C unread (a read drained it) or has no read end left (SIGPIPE if more than C was unread at that close); once every pipe has released it, it settles (that step's settled list) to 141 if any released it by SIGPIPE, else to its own status; final.status is the settled statuses; the scheduler order is lowest runnable pid first, without N24's deferral of children (one valid schedule: replay it in the given order)
